text: Gaunt's Ghosts lost their entire world... on the day they were founded.
Tanith was a world of moving forests. Its people never got lost.
Six thousand of them joined the Imperial Guard, under Colonel-Commissar Ibram Gaunt.
Then a Chaos fleet broke through, straight towards Tanith.
Gaunt had one choice: die defending their home, or save the regiment.
He ordered them to leave. From orbit, they watched Tanith burn.
Major Rawne swore that one day, he would kill Gaunt for it.
All they had left was a silver knife, and a cloak the colour of their forests.
They call themselves the First and Only. There will never be a second.
